automated.summary: All 8 required leaves executed and passed under the vitest discriminator (testcase present in the junit report, not <skipped/>, not <failure/>) - the discriminator matters because vitest exits 0 and marks unmatched leaves skipped (D-0031). Task 1's fifteen leaves pass with their bodies byte-identical; selection-identity.helper.test.ts is untouched, and the only deletions in use-ask.test.tsx are in the shared Harness fixtures adapting to AskTurn.response now being optional while a turn is pending, which criterion c2 requires. 17 tests green across the two task-1 files. verify.py passes. Live on this worktree (backend :4000, frontend :3000): three in-app Open cycles each reached /ask within 80ms of the click - navigate-first, c1 - with cycle 0 appending exactly one turn (unmatched, c2) and cycles 1-2 reusing that same turn so the thread length stayed at 1 (matched, c3, and the duplicate-turn bug this story exists to fix); the target turn was in view after every cycle (c4). The pending turn was measured directly by holding /api/chat open: it renders 'Opening this report...' at 11px slate, matching its sibling status lines. Design pass (both mandatory skills genuinely applied, not merely attested) found two real defects, both fixed and both re-measured live: the pending status line rendered 16px near-black - the loudest text in the thread for a transient loading state - because .ask-period-status has exactly one rule and it is the DESCENDANT selector '.ask-answer .ask-period-status', which a single element carrying both classes does not match; extending that rule to '.ask-answer.ask-period-status' took it 16px ink -> 12px ink -> 11px slate, each step measured with getComputedStyle on the real element. And the progress copy said 'Reopening report...' after a control labelled 'Open', so the action changed verbs mid-flow; it now reads 'Opening this report...'. ROUND 2 (after the quality lens's two partial verdicts, both confirmed in the code and fixed): an ABORTED unmatched reopen used to leave a question with nothing under it, because the catch path cleared isPending without attaching a response or an error and Answer() renders null in that state; the placeholder is now removed on abort, matching the non-reopen path which appends no turn at all. And the scroll effect ran in EVERY AskPanel including surface='docked', so an outgoing docked panel could consume the shared scrollTargetId before the page panel saw it; it is now gated on surface === 'page'. isAbort was also widened from 'instanceof Error' to a structural name check: verified in a real browser that a fetch abort throws a DOMException which satisfies BOTH forms there (DOMException inherits from Error in Chromium), so this changes no production behaviour and only makes the guard hold for cross-realm errors and test doubles. Re-verified after the fixes: 8/8 leaves still execute and pass, the full frontend suite is 133/133 across 20 files, verify.py passes, and three more live Open cycles each settled on /ask with the thread at one turn (no duplicate) and the target in view, so gating the scroll to the page surface did not break it.
